$comment: Frozen Phase 0 cases. Each planner case is an input the provider adapter could emit and the exact plan a correct planner must produce from it. Phase 1 replays them through the pure planner; Phase 3 replays the same bytes through the offline Rust shadow. Written independently of Habit Hooks; no upstream text or fixture is copied.

planner_cases.name: merge-across-rules
planner_cases.proves: Two rules reporting one conceptual anchor render one occurrence carrying both detector records, and every qf-* is preserved.

planner_cases.name: ambiguity-flip
planner_cases.proves: Scan N+1 of the merge case: one contributing rule now reports the anchor twice, so the pair that merged in scan N no longer may. The candidate plan changes; an already promoted finding must not until the replacement plan is reviewed and applied.

planner_cases.name: normalization-collapses
planner_cases.proves: Normalization is the planner's responsibility: observations differing only in whitespace and unicode form reach one anchor. The provider emits raw match and context, so this case would prove nothing if normalization had stayed provider-side.

planner_cases.name: distinct-anchors-stay-distinct
planner_cases.proves: Two different matches in one file from one rule remain two occurrences. Merging is across rules only.

planner_cases.name: incomplete-blocks-promotion
planner_cases.proves: An incomplete snapshot carries typed causes, no observations, and plans no candidates. Incomplete is never clean and never promotable.

planner_cases.name: not-current-is-rejected
planner_cases.proves: An accepted durable finding absent from the current complete scan remains visible as a planner-derived not_current rejection and cannot become a candidate.

guide_cases.name: project-override
guide_cases.proves: A valid project guide outranks the package guide of the same id and language.

guide_cases.name: invalid-override
guide_cases.proves: A project override missing a required section fails closed. It must never fall through to the package guide, which would hide the broken override indefinitely.
